entries.translation: 冷知识：鸭子拥有特殊构造的喙，使它们能在游泳时过滤水和泥中的食物。

entries.source: Fact: Foxes have a unique hunting technique where they use the Earth's magnetic field to pinpoint the exact location of their prey.
entries.translation: 冷知识：狐狸拥有独特的狩猎技巧，它们利用地球磁场精确定位猎物的确切位置。
entries.sampleRaw: §7Fact: Foxes have a unique §7hunting technique where they use §7the Earth's magnetic field to §7pinpoint the exact location of §7their prey.

entries.source: Fact: Sheeps have an excellent sense of smell and can recognize individual members of their flock by their unique scent.
entries.translation: 冷知识：绵羊拥有出色的嗅觉，能通过各自独特的气味辨认羊群中的每一只成员。
entries.sampleRaw: §7Fact: Sheeps have an excellent §7sense of smell and can recognize §7individual members of their §7flock by their unique scent.

entries.source: Fact: Chickens are one of the closest living relative to the Tyrannosaurus Rex.

entries.source: Fact: Penguins have a special gland above their eyes that filters salt from the seawater they ingest.

entries.sampleRaw: §7Fact: Penguins have a special §7gland above their eyes that §7filters salt from the seawater §7they ingest.

entries.source: Fact: Monkeys have been known to use their own fur as a tool to floss their teeth.

entries.source: Fact: Dogs have a unique sense of smell and are even able to detect diseases like cancer and changes in blood sugar levels in people with diabetes.

entries.sampleRaw: §7Fact: Dogs have a unique sense §7of smell and are even able to §7detect diseases like cancer and §7changes in blood sugar levels in §7people with diabetes.

entries.source: Fact: Squids have the ability to change the color and texture of their skin to blend in with their surroundings, communicate with other squids and even hypnotize their prey.
entries.translation: 冷知识：鱿鱼能够改变皮肤的颜色和质地，以融入周围环境、与其他鱿鱼交流，甚至催眠猎物。
entries.sampleRaw: §7Fact: Squids have the ability to §7change the color and texture of §7their skin to blend in with §7their surroundings, communicate §7with other squids and even §7hypnotize their prey.

entries.source: Fact: Toads have glands behind their eyes that secrete bufotoxin, which can cause hallucinations, seizures and death in predators that try to eat them.
entries.translation: 冷知识：蟾蜍眼睛后方有腺体，会分泌蟾毒素，能让试图捕食它们的掠食者产生幻觉、抽搐甚至死亡。
entries.sampleRaw: §7Fact: Toads have glands behind §7their eyes that secrete §7bufotoxin, which can cause §7hallucinations, seizures and §7death in predators that try to §7eat them.

entries.source: ∙ Class Passive: Soul Tether Clicking on a teammate creates a tether connecting yourself to them. Tethered teammates received 0.5% of your maximum health as healing every second while they are within 30 blocks of you. Every 5 melee hits you deal while tethered will heal both players for 1% of their maximum health.
entries.translation: ∙ 职业被动：灵魂束缚 点击一名队友即可在你与他之间建立束缚。被束缚的队友在你 30 格范围内时，每秒获得相当于你最大生命值 0.5% 的治疗。束缚期间你每造成 5 次近战命中，就会为双方各治疗其最大生命值的 1%。

entries.source: You are a bad person for entering a barricaded house without consent!
entries.translation: 未经允许闯入被封锁的房屋，你真是个坏人！
entries.sampleRaw: §cYou are a bad person for entering a barricaded house without consent!

entries.source: And please try to follow the story, a lot of effort went into it.
entries.translation: 另外请尽量跟上剧情，我们为此付出了很多努力。
entries.sampleRaw: §cAnd please try to follow the story, a lot of effort went into it.

entries.source: - Flower Pot -
entries.translation: - 花盆 -

entries.source: This amazing bouquet has been made with love, no doubt about that.
entries.translation: 这束美丽的花毫无疑问是用爱制作的。
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oThis amazing bouquet has been made with love, no doubt about that.

entries.source: - Blood -
entries.translation: - 血迹 -

entries.source: This blood stain has been looked at before.
entries.translation: 这处血迹之前已经查看过了。
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oThis blood stain has been looked at before.

entries.source: That definitely spooked them quite a lot, perhaps they ran away.
entries.translation: 这肯定把他们吓得不轻，也许他们逃走了。
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oThat definitely spooked them quite a lot, perhaps they ran away.

entries.source: But where did they run...
entries.translation: 但他们逃到哪里去了……

entries.source: - Ring -
entries.translation: - 戒指 -

entries.source: This is clearly an engagement ring.
entries.translation: 这显然是一枚订婚戒指。

entries.source: However, there is a curve on the front where there should be a jewel.
entries.translation: 然而，正面本该镶嵌宝石的地方却有一道弧痕。
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oHowever, there is a curve on the front where there should be a jewel.

entries.source: This is incomplete.
entries.translation: 这并不完整。

entries.source: - Fridge -
entries.translation: - 冰箱 -

entries.source: The fridge is empty.
entries.translation: 冰箱是空的。

entries.source: But what are these?
entries.translation: 但这些是什么？

entries.source: BlockDash receipts?? Hundreds of them!
entries.translation: 方块冲刺的收据？？有几百张！

entries.source: - Tall Painting -
entries.translation: - 竖幅画 -

entries.source: It looks like an abstract painting of our victim.
entries.translation: 看起来像是我们受害者的抽象画。
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oIt looks like an abstract painting of our victim.

entries.source: They seem to be wearing a red-ish top and blue jeans.
entries.translation: 他们似乎穿着偏红色的上衣和蓝色牛仔裤。
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oThey seem to be wearing a red-ish top and blue jeans.

entries.source: - Window -
entries.translation: - 窗户 -

entries.source: The attacker might've escaped through this window!
entries.translation: 袭击者可能是从这扇窗户逃走的！
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oThe attacker might've escaped through this window!

entries.source: Or one of the other windows!
entries.translation: 或者从其他某扇窗户！

entries.source: Or through the door!
entries.translation: 或者从门逃走！

entries.source: Or the chimney!!!
entries.translation: 或者是烟囱！！！

entries.source: - Large Painting -
entries.translation: - 大型画作 -

entries.source: A picture of the future wedding.
entries.translation: 一幅未来婚礼的画。

entries.source: This looks like the bride.
entries.translation: 这看起来像新娘。

entries.source: The husband is missing from the picture of course, he will be dead by then...
entries.translation: 当然，新郎不在画中，到那时他已经死了……
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oThe husband is missing from the picture of course, he will be dead by then...

entries.source: Unfortunately the picture is too pixelated to recognize the wife.
entries.translation: 可惜画太像素化了，认不出妻子。
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oUnfortunately the picture is too pixelated to recognize the wife.

entries.source: - Letter -
entries.translation: - 信件 -

entries.source: A love letter!
entries.translation: 一封情书！

entries.source: It appears that they are engaged.
entries.translation: 看来他们已经订婚了。

entries.source: What a tragedy...
entries.translation: 真是悲剧……

entries.source: They might have gone to warn their love of their incoming murder.
entries.translation: 他们可能是去警告爱人即将遭遇的谋杀。
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oThey might have gone to warn their love of their incoming murder.

entries.translation: 与侦探交谈。

entries.source: You can tell by the pixels.
entries.translation: 你可以从像素上看出来。

entries.source: Talk to the detective again.
entries.translation: 再次与侦探交谈。

entries.translation: 你敲了敲木头……

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: To think, I could leave all this behind and find a new path...
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：想想看，我本可以抛下这一切，去寻找一条新的道路……
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: To think, I could leave all this behind and find a new path...

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: It's tempting, to explore the unknown, to see what life holds beyond these tasks.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：去探索未知，去看看这些任务之外的生活是什么样，这很诱人。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: It's tempting, to explore the unknown, to see what life holds beyond these tasks.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: But this place, these routines, they're a part of me.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：但这个地方，这些日常，它们是我的一部分。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: But this place, these routines, they're a part of me.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Deciding isn't simple, and I wonder if I'm ready for what comes with such freedom.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：做决定并不简单，我也在想自己是否准备好面对这种自由带来的一切。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: Deciding isn't simple, and I wonder if I'm ready for what comes with such freedom.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: This choice you've given me, it's more than just a chance to stay or go—it's a question of purpose.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：你给我的这个选择，不只是留下或离开的机会——而是关于意义的问题。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: This choice you've given me, it's more than just a chance to stay or go—it's a question of purpose.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: What else is out there for someone like me?
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：像我这样的存在，外面还有什么在等着呢？
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: What else is out there for someone like me?

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Could there be more to life than endless cycles of work?
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：生活会不会不只是无休止的工作循环？
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: Could there be more to life than endless cycles of work?

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: But then, this is the only home I've ever known.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：可是话说回来，这是我唯一熟悉的家。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: But then, this is the only home I've ever known.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Tough decision, indeed.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：确实是个艰难的决定。

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: To stay or to go...
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：留下，还是离开……
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: To stay or to go...

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I've always wondered what lies beyond these blocks.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：我一直想知道这些方块之外是什么。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: I've always wondered what lies beyond these blocks.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: But then, where would I be without my trusty old workstation?
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：可是话说回来，没有我那可靠的老工作台，我又会在哪里呢？
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: But then, where would I be without my trusty old workstation?

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I never imagined I'd get to decide my own fate.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：我从没想过自己能决定自己的命运。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: I never imagined I'd get to decide my own fate.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Here, I've had my duties, my routines—they've defined me.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：在这里，我有我的职责、我的日常——它们定义了我。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: Here, I've had my duties, my routines—they've defined me.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Outside, who am I?
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：到了外面，我又是谁？

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: It's a daunting thought, but also exhilarating.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：这想法令人畏惧，但也令人兴奋。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: It's a daunting thought, but also exhilarating.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Thank you for this gift of choice, even if I'm not sure what to do with it just yet.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：谢谢你给我这份选择的礼物，即使我还不确定该怎么用它。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: Thank you for this gift of choice, even if I'm not sure what to do with it just yet.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Freedom... it's such a strange and heavy word.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：自由……真是个既陌生又沉重的词。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: Freedom... it's such a strange and heavy word.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: All these years, I've known nothing but the borders of this island and the comfort of routine.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：这些年来，我所知道的只有这座岛的边界和日常的安逸。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: All these years, I've known nothing but the borders of this island and the comfort of routine.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: To leave could mean adventure, or it could mean uncertainty.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：离开可能意味着冒险，也可能意味着不确定。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: To leave could mean adventure, or it could mean uncertainty.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I appreciate the choice, but it's not an easy one to make.
entries.translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：我很感激这个选择，但这并不容易做出。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: I appreciate the choice, but it's not an easy one to make.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: You're really letting me choose?
entries.translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：你真的让我自己选吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: You're really letting me choose?

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: To stay or venture beyond, to continue serving or to seek my own story.
entries.translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：是留下还是去往远方，是继续效力还是追寻我自己的故事。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: To stay or venture beyond, to continue serving or to seek my own story.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: It's overwhelming but also liberating.
entries.translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：这让人不知所措，但也让人感到自由。
entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: It's overwhelming but also liberating.

entries.source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Every swing of my <tool>, every <block I've dug / ore I've mined / crop I've harvested / monster I've killed / tree I've chopped> it's all been leading to this moment of choice.

entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: Every swing of my <tool>, every <block I've dug / ore I've mined / crop I've harvested / monster I've killed / tree I've chopped> it's all been leading to this moment of choice.

entries.translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：你给了我多么深刻的东西，而我又必须做出多么深刻的决定。

entries.sampleRaw: §e[MINION] <type> Minion§f: I've thought long and hard, and it's clear to me now.

entries.source: BRAINLESS! You don't feel all that different, though you do feel a bit more confident in your times tables...
entries.translation: 无脑！你感觉没什么不同，不过你对乘法口诀表倒是更有信心了……
entries.sampleRaw: §d§lBRAINLESS! §fYou don't feel all that different, though you do feel a bit more confident in your times tables...

entries.source: BRAINY! A variety of "fun" facts swirl around in your skull. Did you know these before?
entries.translation: 聪明！各种“有趣”的冷知识在你脑中盘旋。你以前知道这些吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §d§lBRAINY! §fA variety of "fun" facts swirl around in your skull. Did you know these before?

entries.source: BRAINPOWER! You look up the sky, and the constellations begin to make sense. Voiceless, they speak to you.
entries.translation: 脑力！你仰望天空，星座开始变得清晰。它们无声地向你诉说。
entries.sampleRaw: §d§lBRAINPOWER! §fYou look up the sky, and the constellations begin to make sense. Voiceless, they speak to you.

entries.source: BRAINROT! Who is the Sphinx to be questioning you, anyway? The Sphinx cannot think like YOU can.
entries.translation: 脑腐！斯芬克斯凭什么来质问你？斯芬克斯可没法像你那样思考。
entries.sampleRaw: §d§lBRAINROT! §fWho is the Sphinx to be questioning you, anyway? The Sphinx cannot think like YOU can.

entries.source: BRAINFREEZE! Every. single. digit. of pi, etched into your brain. You are the first to have reached the end. Sit down for a while and ruminate in your supreme intellect.
entries.translation: 脑冻结！圆周率的每。一。位。数字。都刻进了你的大脑。你是第一个抵达终点的人。坐下来，用你超凡的智慧好好沉思一会儿吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §d§lBRAINFREEZE! §fEvery. single. digit. of pi, etched into your brain. You are the first to have reached the end. Sit down for a while and ruminate in your supreme intellect.

entries.translation: 你的宠物没有持有任何物品！

entries.source: Unlock the Foraging Skill at Lumber Jack.
entries.translation: 在Lumber Jack解锁采集技能.

entries.source: Purchase Foraging Tools from the Lumber Merchant.
entries.translation: 从Lumber Merchant处购买采集工具.
entries.sampleRaw: Purchase Foraging Tools from the §2Lumber Merchant§f.

entries.source: Travel to the Birch Park.
entries.translation: 前往白桦公园.

entries.source: Buy Combat Tools from the Weaponsmith and Rosetta.
entries.translation: 从Weaponsmith和Rosetta处购买战斗工具。

entries.source: Talk to Jax at the Archery Range to learn about bows and arrows.
entries.translation: 在射箭场与Jax交谈，了解弓和箭。
entries.sampleRaw: §fTalk to §cJax §fat the §3Archery Range §fto learn about bows and arrows.

entries.source: Learn about Enchanting at the Library.
entries.translation: 在图书馆了解附魔。

entries.source: Talk to Maxwell at the Thaumaturgist to learn about Magical Power.
entries.translation: 在奇术师居所与Maxwell交谈，了解魔法力量。

entries.source: Purchase Mining Tools from the Mining Merchant.
entries.translation: 从Mining Merchant处购买采矿工具.

entries.source: Learn about Reforges at the Blacksmith.
entries.translation: 在铁匠铺了解洗练.

entries.source: Travel to the Coal Mine.
entries.translation: 前往煤矿.

entries.source: May contain rats.
entries.translation: 可能含有老鼠。

entries.source: CAUGHT! You cocooned a <mob name>!
entries.translation: 捕获！你将一个<mob name>裹进了茧里！

entries.source: Help Grandpa Wolf with Frozen Corpse Milestones.
entries.translation: 帮助Grandpa Wolf完成冰冻尸体里程碑.

entries.source: View the Frozen Corpse RNG Meter.
entries.translation: 查看冰冻尸体 RNG 计量表.

entries.translation: 一只鱿鱼出现了。

entries.source: Talk to the Lazy Miner.
entries.translation: 与 Lazy Miner 交谈。

entries.source: Visit the Blacksmith.
entries.translation: 拜访铁匠铺。

entries.source: Talk to Rusty.
entries.translation: 与 Rusty 交谈。

entries.source: Auction off your special items.

entries.source: Gather Wheat.

entries.translation: 开采黑曜石和钻石矿石。

entries.source: Talk to Rhys.
entries.translation: 与Rhys交谈.

entries.source: The Miner Zombies and Skeletons here are even more
entries.translation: 这里的矿工僵尸和骷髅甚至更加

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Congratulations, you made it through the Entrance.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：恭喜，你成功通过了入口。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Congratulations, you made it through the Entrance.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I have been watching you closely...
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我一直在密切注视着你……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: I have been watching you closely...

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Unfortunately, for now, this is the end of the road.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：不幸的是，目前这就是路的尽头了。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Unfortunately, for now, this is the end of the road.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I sense many dead spirits eager to return to the living..
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我感应到许多渴望重返人间的亡魂……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: I sense many dead spirits eager to return to the living..

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I will bring some of them back. Watch this.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我会把其中一些带回来。看好了。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: I will bring some of them back. Watch this.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ah, you've finally arrived.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：啊，你终于来了。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Ah, you've finally arrived.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I have been watching you closely since we last met.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：自上次见面以来，我一直在密切注视着你。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: I have been watching you closely since we last met.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I don't know if you are ready for what's behind this door.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我不知道你是否准备好面对这扇门后的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: I don't know if you are ready for what's behind this door.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: So I will decide if you are strong enough.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：那就由我来决定你是否足够强大。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: So I will decide if you are strong enough.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ah, we meet again...
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：啊，我们又见面了……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Ah, we meet again...

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I have done some experiments to develop new abilities for my Skulls.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我做了一些实验，为我的头颅开发了新能力。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: I have done some experiments to develop new abilities for my Skulls.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Let's see how you handle this!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：看看你如何应对这个！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Let's see how you handle this!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: So you made it this far... interesting.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：你竟然走到了这一步……有意思。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: So you made it this far... interesting.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: You are much stronger than I was expecting.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：你比我预想的要强得多。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: You are much stronger than I was expecting.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Not to worry, I recently added a very fine piece to my collection!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：别担心，我最近往收藏里添了一件非常精美的藏品！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Not to worry, I recently added a very fine piece to my collection!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: You've managed to scratch and claw your way here, eh?
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：你竟然一路连抓带爬地来到了这里，嗯？
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: You've managed to scratch and claw your way here, eh?

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Don't even think about trying to outwit me this time!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：这次连想都别想试图智取我！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Don't even think about trying to outwit me this time!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: My Watchful Eyes are keeping their...eyes...on you!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我的警觉之眼正把它们的……眼睛……盯着你呢！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: My Watchful Eyes are keeping their...eyes...on you!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I'm starting to get tired of seeing you around here...
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我开始厌倦在这里看到你了……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: I'm starting to get tired of seeing you around here...

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: This time I've imbued my minions with special properties!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：这次我给我的仆从注入了特殊属性！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: This time I've imbued my minions with special properties!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: <modifier line>
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：<modifier line>

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will be healthier than any summon I've ever created!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：这些会比我创造过的任何召唤物都更健康！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: These will be healthier than any summon I've ever created!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will be adorned in the finest gold!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：这些将披上最精美的黄金！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: These will be adorned in the finest gold!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will strike thunder from the sky!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：这些将从天而降，击出雷霆！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: These will strike thunder from the sky!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will be stubborn and unwilling to change!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：这些将固执己见，不愿改变！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: These will be stubborn and unwilling to change!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will be quick and agile!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：这些将迅捷而灵活！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: These will be quick and agile!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will be kinda hard to see ngl.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：说实话，这些会有点难看清。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: These will be kinda hard to see ngl.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Oh.. hello?
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：哦……你好？

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: You've arrived too early, I haven't even set up..
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：你来得太早了，我还没布置好……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: You've arrived too early, I haven't even set up..

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Anyway, let's fight.. I guess.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：总之，我们开打吧……大概。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Anyway, let's fight.. I guess.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Things feel a little more roomy now, eh?
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：现在感觉宽敞了一点，嗯？
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Things feel a little more roomy now, eh?

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I've knocked down those pillars to go for a more...open concept.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我推倒了那些柱子，好走一种更……开放的设计风格。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: I've knocked down those pillars to go for a more...open concept.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Plus I needed to give my new friends some space to roam...
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：再说我也需要给我的新朋友们一些活动空间……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Plus I needed to give my new friends some space to roam...

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: This guy looks like a fighter.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：这家伙看起来像个战士。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: This guy looks like a fighter.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Go and live again!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：去，重获新生吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Go and live again!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Not bad.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：不错。

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: You'll do.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：你还算合格。

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Go, fight!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：上，战斗吧！

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Hmmm... this one!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：嗯……就这个！

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Let's see how you can handle this.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：让我看看你能应付到什么程度。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Let's see how you can handle this.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I'm impressed.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我印象深刻。

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: That one was weak anyway.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：反正那个本来就很弱。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: That one was weak anyway.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Aw, I liked that one.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：唉，我还挺喜欢那个的。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Aw, I liked that one.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Very nice.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：很不错。

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: That tickles.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：有点痒。

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I am not your enemy.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我不是你的敌人。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: I am not your enemy.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Stop attacking me.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：别攻击我。

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Don't make me shoot you.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：别逼我射你。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: Don't make me shoot you.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ouch.. just kidding.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：哎哟……开玩笑的。

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: My Watchful Eyes see you up there! Come down and fight!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我的凝视之眼看到你在上面了！下来战斗！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: My Watchful Eyes see you up there! Come down and fight!

entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我们一直在看着。从上面下来！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: We are always watching. Come down from there!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: My Watchful Eyes see all!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher：我的凝视之眼无所不见！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Watcher§f: My Watchful Eyes see all!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Don't try to sneak anything past my Watchful Eyes. They see you up there!

entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: These wounds are nothing for my Giga Heal!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: How do you like the taste of Gunpowder?
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：尝尝火药的味道如何？
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: How do you like the taste of Gunpowder?

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Another flawless Giga Heal. You are making this too easy for me!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：又一次完美的超级治疗。你让我赢得太轻松了！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: Another flawless Giga Heal. You are making this too easy for me!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I see. You have forced me to use my ultimate technique.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：我明白了。你逼我使出终极绝招。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: I see. You have forced me to use my ultimate technique.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: These Guardians aren't just for show I'm afraid!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：恐怕这些守护者可不只是摆设！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: These Guardians aren't just for show I'm afraid!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: The process is irreversible, but I'll be stronger than a Wither now!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：这个过程不可逆转，但我现在会比凋灵还强大！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: The process is irreversible, but I'll be stronger than a Wither now!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Now that you have fallen, my student has been avenged.
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：既然你已倒下，我的学生也算大仇得报了。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: Now that you have fallen, my student has been avenged.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Picking a fight with me and my experiments will only lead to your demise!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：跟我还有我的实验品作对，只会让你自取灭亡！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: Picking a fight with me and my experiments will only lead to your demise!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I give you an F-!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：我给你打个 F-！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: I give you an F-!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: What?! My Guardian power is unbeatable!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：什么？！我的守护者之力无可匹敌！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: What?! My Guardian power is unbeatable!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: How could you... I needed more power...
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：你怎么可能……我还需要更多力量……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: How could you... I needed more power...

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I can't let my Master hear about this.. he'll kill m-
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：我不能让我的主人听到这件事……他会杀了我的——
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: I can't let my Master hear about this.. he'll kill m-

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: That is enough, fool!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：够了，蠢货！

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: Adventurers! Be careful of who you are messing with...
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：冒险者们！小心你们招惹的是谁……
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: Adventurers! Be careful of who you are messing with...

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: Before I have to deal with you myself.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：免得我不得不亲自对付你们。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: Before I have to deal with you myself.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Professor: My Guardians! Show them your power!
entries.translation: [BOSS] The Professor：我的守护者们！让他们见识你们的力量！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] The Professor§f: My Guardians! Show them your power!

entries.source: Wow! [player] found a Phoenix pet!
entries.translation: 哇！[player] 发现了一只凤凰宠物！

entries.source: The Loch Emperor arises from the depths.
entries.translation: 尼斯湖帝王从深处浮现。
entries.sampleRaw: §aThe Loch Emperor arises from the depths.

entries.source: Is that even a fish? It's the Carrot King!
entries.translation: 那也算鱼？是胡萝卜之王！
entries.sampleRaw: §aIs that even a fish? It's the Carrot King!

entries.source: Woah! You didn't select an Accessory Bag power!
entries.translation: 哇!你还没有选择饰品袋能力!

entries.source: Visit Maxwell the Thaumaturgist in the Hub to fix that ASAP!
entries.translation: 前往中心岛拜访奇术师居所的 Maxwell，尽快解决这个问题！
entries.sampleRaw: §eVisit Maxwell the §6Thaumaturgist §ein the §aHub §eto fix that ASAP!

entries.source: You had # blacklisted items in your Accessory Bag, they have been deleted! Sorry!
entries.translation: 你的饰品袋中有 # 个被列入黑名单的物品，它们已被删除！抱歉！
entries.sampleRaw: §cYou had # blacklisted items in your Accessory Bag, they have been deleted! Sorry!

entries.source: Seems like the winner was offline! If you find them somewhere, tell them Jerry has their item.
entries.translation: 看来获胜者离线了！如果你在哪里找到他们，告诉他们 Jerry 持有他们的物品。
entries.sampleRaw: §eSeems like the winner was offline! If you find them somewhere, tell them Jerry has their item.

entries.source: Pitch Darkness reveals a Night Squid.
entries.translation: 漆黑一片中浮现出一只夜鱿鱼。

entries.source: Join Dungeons!
entries.translation: 加入地牢！

entries.source: Meet new friends and organize Dungeon parties!
entries.translation: 结识新朋友并组织地牢队伍！
entries.sampleRaw: Meet new friends and organize Dungeon parties!

entries.source: Talk with Ophelia and Malik.
entries.translation: 与 Ophelia 和 Malik 交谈.

entries.source: Use the egg I gave you to click and point to where you want me to go!
entries.translation: 用我给你的鸡蛋点击并指向你想让我去的地方！
entries.sampleRaw: §aUse the egg I gave you to click and point to where you want me to go!

entries.source: Why would you try? :(
entries.translation: 你为什么要尝试？:(

entries.source: You can't move Jerry here! He doesn't belong here!
entries.translation: 你不能把 Jerry 移到这里！他不属于这里！
entries.sampleRaw: §cYou can't move Jerry here! He doesn't belong here!

entries.source: Guests can't place Jerry or Sam! But you know that, right?
entries.translation: 访客不能放置 Jerry 或 Sam！但你知道的，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §cGuests can't place Jerry or Sam! But you know that, right?

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: Finally, I heard so much about you. The Eye likes you very much.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：终于，我听说过很多关于你的事。那只眼睛非常喜欢你。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: Finally, I heard so much about you. The Eye likes you very much.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: You went further than any human before, congratulations.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：你走得比任何人类都更远，恭喜。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: You went further than any human before, congratulations.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: I'm afraid, your journey ends now.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：恐怕你的旅程到此为止了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: I'm afraid, your journey ends now.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: My master and I spent centuries building this factory...and this army.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：我和我的主人花了几个世纪建造这座工厂……以及这支军队。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: My master and I spent centuries building this factory...and this army.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: I won't allow you to destroy it all now.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：我不会允许你现在把这一切都毁掉。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: I won't allow you to destroy it all now.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: Goodbye.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：再见。

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: That's a very impressive trick. I guess I'll have to handle this myself.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：这招真是令人印象深刻。看来我得亲自处理这件事了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: That's a very impressive trick. I guess I'll have to handle this myself.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: I ensure you, these blades are far sharper than Goldor's ever were.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：我向你保证，这些刀刃可比 Goldor 的锋利多了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: I ensure you, these blades are far sharper than Goldor's ever were.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: All this, for nothing...
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：这一切，都白费了……

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: I understand your words now, my master.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：我现在明白您的话了，我的主人。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: I understand your words now, my master.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: The Catacombs... are no more.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：地牢……不复存在了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: The Catacombs... are no more.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: FINALLY! This took way too long.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：终于！这花了太长时间了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: FINALLY! This took way too long.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：既然你现在是幽灵了，能帮我清理一下吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: You merely adopted the Catacombs! I was molded by them!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：你只是接受了地牢！而我是在地牢中塑造出来的！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: You merely adopted the Catacombs! I was molded by them!

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: I - Necron - was destined to rule over Mankind! Dead or Alive!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：我——Necron——注定要统治人类！无论生死！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: I - Necron - was destined to rule over Mankind! Dead or Alive!

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: The Catacombs made you stronger, but can you beat me?!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：地牢让你变强了，但你能打败我吗？！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: The Catacombs made you stronger, but can you beat me?!

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: Show me how you beat Storm!!!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：让我看看你是怎么打败 Storm 的！！！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: Show me how you beat Storm!!!

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: Not just your Village, but the whole world will end!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：不只是你的村庄，整个世界都将终结！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: Not just your Village, but the whole world will end!

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: Fight for your life!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：为你的生命而战！

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: Sometimes when you have a problem, you just need to destroy it all and start again.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：有时候当你遇到问题时，你只需要把一切摧毁再重新开始。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: Sometimes when you have a problem, you just need to destroy it all and start again.

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: WITNESS MY RAW NUCLEAR POWER!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：见证我纯粹的核能吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: WITNESS MY RAW NUCLEAR POWER!

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: IF YOU WANT TO STAY COOL, DON'T LOOK!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：如果你想保持凉爽，就别看！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Necron§c: IF YOU WANT TO STAY COOL, DON'T LOOK!

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
[BOSS] Necron: HASTA LA VISTA, BABY!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：后会有期，宝贝！

entries.source: [BOSS] Necron: ARGH!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Necron：呃啊！

entries.source: You caught a Sea Walker.
entries.translation: 你钓到了一只海行者。

entries.source: Fight Endermen and Endermites.
entries.translation: 击败末影人和末影螨。

entries.source: Mine End Stone and Obsidian.
entries.translation: 开采末地石和黑曜石。

entries.source: Travel to the Dragon's Nest.
entries.translation: 前往龙巢。

entries.source: You've stumbled upon a Sea Guardian.
entries.translation: 你偶然遇到了一只海守卫。

entries.source: This ability can only be used inside dungeons!
entries.translation: 此能力只能在地牢内使用！
entries.sampleRaw: §cThis ability can only be used inside dungeons!

entries.source: The Diamond Reserve can now be traveled to via the Lift
entries.translation: 现在可以通过升降梯前往钻石矿区了

styleMappings.can now be traveled to via the Lift: 现在可以通过升降梯前往

entries.sampleRaw: The §bDiamond Reserve§f can now be traveled to via the Lift

entries.source: Mine Diamond Ore.
entries.translation: 开采钻石矿石。

entries.source: The Miner Zombies and Skeletons are highly dangerous!
entries.translation: 矿工僵尸和骷髅极其危险！
entries.sampleRaw: The Miner Zombies and Skeletons are highly dangerous!

entries.source: You reeled in a Sea Archer.
entries.translation: 你钓到了一只海弓手。

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Welcome Adventurers! I am Thorn, the Spirit! And host of the Vegan Trials!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：欢迎，冒险者们！我是 Thorn，灵魂！也是纯素试炼的主办者！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Welcome Adventurers! I am Thorn, the Spirit! And host of the Vegan Trials!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: My Arena is the most entertaining place in all the Catacombs!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：我的竞技场是整个地牢里最有趣的地方！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: My Arena is the most entertaining place in all the Catacombs!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Today you'll be our spectacle.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：今天你们将成为我们的表演。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Today you'll be our spectacle.

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Dance! Dance with my Spirit animals! And may you perish in a delightful way!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：跳舞吧！与我的灵魂动物共舞！愿你们以愉快的方式死去！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Dance! Dance with my Spirit animals! And may you perish in a delightful way!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Tickle tickle, you are in a pickle!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：挠挠痒痒，你陷入困境啦！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Tickle tickle, you are in a pickle!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: I'm already dead adventurer! Earthly weapons won't affect me!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：我早已死去，冒险者！凡间武器对我无效！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: I'm already dead adventurer! Earthly weapons won't affect me!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Don't waste your energy on me, humans - I am Thorn the Spirit!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：别把精力浪费在我身上，人类——我是灵魂 Thorn！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Don't waste your energy on me, humans - I am Thorn the Spirit!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: I love your fighting spirit, but I am immune to your tricks!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：我喜欢你们的战斗精神，但我对你的把戏免疫！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: I love your fighting spirit, but I am immune to your tricks!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Trying to damage me like that...desperate...
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：想这样伤害我……真是绝望……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Trying to damage me like that...desperate...

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: I feel...dizzy...
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：我感觉……头晕……

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: It hurts...what a delicate feeling...
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：好痛……多么微妙的感觉……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: It hurts...what a delicate feeling...

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Round and round, another wound.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：转啊转，又添一伤。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Round and round, another wound.

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: My energy, it goes away...
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：我的能量，正在消散……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: My energy, it goes away...

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Go my Spirits, go! Unsullied souls!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：去吧我的灵魂，去吧！纯洁无瑕的灵魂！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Go my Spirits, go! Unsullied souls!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: More Spirits! Born of feathers and light!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：更多灵魂！由羽毛与光诞生！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: More Spirits! Born of feathers and light!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Dance for me humans! Your Art will be remembered!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：为我起舞吧人类！你们的艺术将被铭记！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Dance for me humans! Your Art will be remembered!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Can you hear the crowd?! The sound of death!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：你们能听到人群的声音吗？！死亡之声！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Can you hear the crowd?! The sound of death!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Jump and laugh, scream and cry! Be passionate!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：跳跃欢笑，尖叫哭泣！尽情投入吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Jump and laugh, scream and cry! Be passionate!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Wonderful performance humans, truly beautiful.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：精彩的表演人类，真是美丽。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Wonderful performance humans, truly beautiful.

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: How one dies shows how one lived. And it was your masterpiece.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：一个人如何死去，便显示他如何活过。而这是你们的杰作。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: How one dies shows how one lived. And it was your masterpiece.

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A rabbit!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：你将变成什么灵魂？对！一只兔子！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A rabbit!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chihuahua!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：你将变成什么灵魂？对！一只吉娃娃！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chihuahua!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A sheep!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：你将变成什么灵魂？对！一只羊！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A sheep!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chicken!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：你将变成什么灵魂？对！一只鸡！
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chicken!

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: This is it...where shall I go now?
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：就是现在……我该去哪里呢？
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: This is it...where shall I go now?

entries.source: [BOSS] Thorn: All those memories will be lost in time, like tears in rain...
entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：所有那些记忆都将随时间消逝，如同雨中的泪水……
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: All those memories will be lost in time, like tears in rain...

entries.translation: [BOSS] Thorn：恭喜人类，你们可以通过了。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[BOSS] Thorn§f: Congratulations humans, you may pass.

entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：太奇妙了！你们这些鲁莽的人类竟没有放过任何一只沉睡的魔像！谢了，[player]！

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: I've never seen such carelessness in my years as a Necromancer! So little regard for my Golems, and even less regard for your own lives! Blame [player]!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：我当死灵法师这么多年，从没见过如此粗心大意！对我的魔像毫不在意，对你们自己的性命更是如此！都怪[player]！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: I've never seen such carelessness in my years as a Necromancer! So little regard for my Golems, and even less regard for your own lives! Blame [player]!

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: My Terracotta Army is using some of the finest souls - old warriors and wizards!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：我的兵马俑大军使用的是最上等的灵魂——古老的战士与巫师！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: My Terracotta Army is using some of the finest souls - old warriors and wizards!

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: You will be humbled, reckless humans!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：你们会谦卑下来的，鲁莽的人类！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: You will be humbled, reckless humans!

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Can you at least enjoy my science, pushing the boundaries of Necromancy!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：你们至少能欣赏一下我的科学吧，这可是在拓展死灵术的边界！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: Can you at least enjoy my science, pushing the boundaries of Necromancy!

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Corpses are deficient, full of weaknesses. Statues are stronger, faster, and easier to repair.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：尸体有缺陷，满是弱点。雕像则更强、更快，也更容易修复。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: Corpses are deficient, full of weaknesses. Statues are stronger, faster, and easier to repair.

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Can't you see that there is no winning? This room will be your tomb.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：你们难道看不出根本没有胜算吗？这个房间就是你们的坟墓。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: Can't you see that there is no winning? This room will be your tomb.

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: So much effort, for what? You should have joined us instead, Necron will cure this world!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：费了这么大劲，图什么？你们本该加入我们，奈克隆会治愈这个世界！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: So much effort, for what? You should have joined us instead, Necron will cure this world!

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Terrible...terrible...,
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：糟糕……太糟糕了……，

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: I'm growing tired of this folly. My Giants are restless.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：我对这场闹剧越来越厌倦了。我的巨人们已经按捺不住了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: I'm growing tired of this folly. My Giants are restless.

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: It's about time we see what my Giants can do...
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：是时候看看我的巨人们能做什么了……
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: It's about time we see what my Giants can do...

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Rumor has it those are dead Precursors, legendary civilization.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：传闻说那些是死去的先驱者，一个传奇文明。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: Rumor has it those are dead Precursors, legendary civilization.

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: My first time using them, extremely interesting!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：这是我第一次使用它们，极其有趣！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: My first time using them, extremely interesting!

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Which one is your favorite? Those laser eyes...beautiful!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：你最喜欢哪一个？那些激光眼……真美！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: Which one is your favorite? Those laser eyes...beautiful!

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: This is what peak Necromancy looks like!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：这就是死灵术的巅峰模样！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: This is what peak Necromancy looks like!

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Boulders, lasers, stomping, and giant swords! Oh my!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：巨石、激光、践踏，还有巨剑！天哪！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: Boulders, lasers, stomping, and giant swords! Oh my!

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: ENOUGH!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：够了！

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: My giants! Unleashed!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：我的巨人们！释放吧！

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: You did it. I understand now, you have earned my respect.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：你们做到了。我现在明白了，你们赢得了我的尊重。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: You did it. I understand now, you have earned my respect.

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: If only you had become my disciples instead of this incompetent bunch.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：要是你们成了我的弟子，而不是这群无能之辈就好了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: If only you had become my disciples instead of this incompetent bunch.

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Maybe in another life. Until then, meet my ultimate corpse.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：也许来世吧。在那之前，见识一下我的终极尸体。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: Maybe in another life. Until then, meet my ultimate corpse.

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: I'm sorry but I need to concentrate. I wish it didn't have to come to this.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：抱歉，但我需要集中精神。我真希望事情不必走到这一步。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: I'm sorry but I need to concentrate. I wish it didn't have to come to this.

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: You thought I'd fall for the same tricks as those before me? Not today!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：你以为我会中和我之前那些人一样的把戏？今天可不会！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: You thought I'd fall for the same tricks as those before me? Not today!

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: It was inevitable. You are fighting forces beyond your imagination.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：这是不可避免的。你们正在对抗超乎想象的力量。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: It was inevitable. You are fighting forces beyond your imagination.

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: No adventurer can see what lays beyond this floor.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：没有冒险者能窥见这一层之外的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] §cSadan§f: No adventurer can see what lays beyond this floor.

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Rest in peace.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：安息吧。

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: NOOOOOOOOO!!! THIS IS IMPOSSIBLE!!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：不oooooooooo！！！这不可能！！

entries.source: [BOSS] Sadan: FATHER, FORGIVE ME!!!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Sadan：父亲，原谅我！！！

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: WELL WELL WELL LOOK WHO'S HERE!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：好好好，看看是谁来了！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: WELL WELL WELL LOOK WHO'S HERE!

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: I'VE BEEN TOLD I COULD HAVE A BIT OF FUN WITH YOU.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：我听说我可以跟你玩一玩。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: I'VE BEEN TOLD I COULD HAVE A BIT OF FUN WITH YOU.

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: DON'T DISAPPOINT ME, I HAVEN'T HAD A GOOD FIGHT IN A WHILE.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：别让我失望，我已经很久没打过一场好架了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: DON'T DISAPPOINT ME, I HAVEN'T HAD A GOOD FIGHT IN A WHILE.

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: YOU TRICKED ME!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：你耍了我！

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: THAT BEAM! IT HURTS! IT HURTS!!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：那道光束！好痛！好痛！！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: THAT BEAM! IT HURTS! IT HURTS!!

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: I'M TOO YOUNG TO DIE AGAIN!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：我还太年轻，不能再死一次！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: I'M TOO YOUNG TO DIE AGAIN!

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: I'LL MAKE YOU REMEMBER MY DEATH!!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：我会让你记住我的死！！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: I'LL MAKE YOU REMEMBER MY DEATH!!

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: FINALLY! This took way too long.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：终于！这花的时间也太久了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: FINALLY! This took way too long.

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：既然你成了幽灵，能帮我清理一下吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: YOUR WEAPONS CAN'T PIERCE THROUGH MY SHIELD!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：你的武器刺不穿我的护盾！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: YOUR WEAPONS CAN'T PIERCE THROUGH MY SHIELD!

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: YOUR MOBILITY TRICKS DON'T WORK IN MY DOMAIN!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：你的机动把戏在我的领域里不管用！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: YOUR MOBILITY TRICKS DON'T WORK IN MY DOMAIN!

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: I HOPE YOU LIKE EXPLOSIONS TOO!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：希望你也喜欢爆炸！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: I HOPE YOU LIKE EXPLOSIONS TOO!

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: MY MINIONS WILL HAVE TO WIPE THE FLOOR AFTER I'M DONE WITH YOU ALL!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：等我收拾完你们，我的仆从还得擦地板！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: MY MINIONS WILL HAVE TO WIPE THE FLOOR AFTER I'M DONE WITH YOU ALL!

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: How about you taste some rapid fire Wither Skulls!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：不如尝尝连发的凋灵骷髅头吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: How about you taste some rapid fire Wither Skulls!

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: Eat Wither Skulls, scum!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：吃凋灵骷髅头吧，渣滓！

entries.source: [BOSS] Maxor: Time for me to blast you away for good!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Maxor：是时候把你们彻底轰飞了！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Maxor§c: Time for me to blast you away for good!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: Pathetic Maxor, just like expected.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：可悲的 Maxor，果然不出所料。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: Pathetic Maxor, just like expected.

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: Don't boast about beating this simple minded Wither.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：别因为打败这个头脑简单的凋灵就自吹自擂。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: Don't boast about beating this simple minded Wither.

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: My abilities are unparalleled, in many ways I am the last bastion.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：我的能力无与伦比，从很多方面来说，我就是最后的堡垒。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: My abilities are unparalleled, in many ways I am the last bastion.

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: The memory of your death will be your fondest, focus up!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：你死亡的记忆将是你最美好的回忆，集中精神！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: The memory of your death will be your fondest, focus up!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: The power of lightning is quite phenomenal. A single strike can vaporize a person whole.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：闪电的力量相当惊人。一击就能把一个人彻底蒸发。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: The power of lightning is quite phenomenal. A single strike can vaporize a person whole.

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: I'd be happy to show you what that's like!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：我很乐意让你见识一下那是什么感觉！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: I'd be happy to show you what that's like!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: THUNDER LET ME BE YOUR CATALYST!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：雷霆，让我成为你的催化剂！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: THUNDER LET ME BE YOUR CATALYST!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: ENERGY HEED MY CALL!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：能量，听从我的召唤！

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: Bahahaha! Not a single intact pillar remains!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：哈哈哈！一根完好的柱子都不剩了！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: Bahahaha! Not a single intact pillar remains!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: Rejoice, your last moments are with me and my lightning.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：欢呼吧，你的最后时刻将与我及我的闪电同在。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: Rejoice, your last moments are with me and my lightning.

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: I should have known that I stood no chance.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：我早该知道，我毫无胜算。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: I should have known that I stood no chance.

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: At least my son died by your hands.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：至少我的儿子是死在你的手上。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: At least my son died by your hands.

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: FINALLY! This took way too long.
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：终于！这花的时间也太久了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: FINALLY! This took way too long.

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：既然你已经是幽灵了，能帮我清理一下吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: The Age of Men is over, we are creating tens, hundreds of withers!!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：人类的时代结束了，我们正在创造数十、数百个凋灵！！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: The Age of Men is over, we are creating tens, hundreds of withers!!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: Not just your land, but every kingdom will soon be ruled by our army of undead!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：不只是你的土地，所有王国很快都将被我们的亡灵大军统治！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: Not just your land, but every kingdom will soon be ruled by our army of undead!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: The days are numbered until I am finally unleashed again on the world!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：我再次被释放到这个世界上的日子已经屈指可数了！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: The days are numbered until I am finally unleashed again on the world!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: No more adventurers, no more heroes, death and thunder!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：不再有冒险者，不再有英雄，只有死亡与雷霆！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: No more adventurers, no more heroes, death and thunder!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: Fool, I'd hide under something next time if I were you!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：蠢货，下次换作是我，我会躲到什么东西下面！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: Fool, I'd hide under something next time if I were you!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: Oof
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：哎哟

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: Ouch, that hurt!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：哎哟，好痛！

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: THAT WAS ONLY IN MY WAY!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：那只是挡了我的路而已！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: THAT WAS ONLY IN MY WAY!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: This factory is too small for me!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：这座工厂对我来说太小了！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: This factory is too small for me!

entries.source: [BOSS] Storm: Slowing me down will be your greatest accomplishment!
entries.translation: [BOSS] Storm：拖慢我的脚步将是你最大的成就！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] Storm§c: Slowing me down will be your greatest accomplishment!

entries.source: Opal is a hydrated amorphous form of silica (SiO2·nH2O); its water content may range from 3 to 21% by weight, but is usually between 6 and 10%. Because of its amorphous character, it is classed as a mineraloid, unlike crystalline forms of silica, which are classed as minerals. It is deposited at a relatively low temperature and may occur in the fissures of almost any kind of rock, being most commonly found with limonite, sandstone, rhyolite, marl, and basalt. There are two broad classes of opal: precious and common. Precious opal displays play-of-color (iridescence), common opal does not. Play-of-color is defined as “a pseudo chromatic optical effect resulting in flashes of colored light from certain minerals, as they are turned in white light.“ The internal structure of precious opal causes it to diffract light, resulting in play-of-color. Depending on the conditions in which it formed, opal may be transparent, translucent, or opaque and the background color may be white, black, or nearly any color of the visual spectrum. Black opal is considered to be the rarest, whereas white, gray, and green are the most common.
entries.translation: 蛋白石是二氧化硅（SiO2·nH2O）的水合无定形形态；其含水量按重量计可能在 3 到 21% 之间，但通常介于 6 和 10% 之间。由于其无定形特性，它被归类为准矿物，不同于被归类为矿物的结晶态二氧化硅。它在相对较低的温度下沉积，可能出现在几乎任何岩石的裂隙中，最常见于褐铁矿、砂岩、流纹岩、泥灰岩和玄武岩中。蛋白石分为两大类：珍贵蛋白石和普通蛋白石。珍贵蛋白石会呈现变彩（晕彩），普通蛋白石则不会。变彩被定义为“某些矿物在白光下转动时，产生彩色闪光的一种伪彩色光学效应”。珍贵蛋白石的内部结构使其衍射光线，从而产生变彩。根据其形成条件，蛋白石可能透明、半透明或不透明，底色可能是白色、黑色或几乎任何可见光谱中的颜色。黑蛋白石被认为是最稀有的，而白色、灰色和绿色则最为常见。

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Ohh?
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：哦？

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Awakening me from my slumber, what a strange choice.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：把我从沉睡中唤醒，真是个奇怪的选择。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Awakening me from my slumber, what a strange choice.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I have nothing left to fight for, I finally had peace.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：我已经没有什么可为之战斗的了，我终于得到了安宁。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: I have nothing left to fight for, I finally had peace.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: You... again?
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：你……又来了？

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I no longer wish to fight, but I know that will not stop you.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：我已不再想战斗，但我知道这阻止不了你。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: I no longer wish to fight, but I know that will not stop you.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: We will decide it all, here, now.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：就在这里，就在此刻，我们将决定一切。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: We will decide it all, here, now.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: My enemies are now my strongest allies!
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：我的敌人如今成了我最强大的盟友！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: My enemies are now my strongest allies!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Does that mean Necron is no more? I have been a mediocre master.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：这是否意味着奈克隆已经不在了？我一直是个平庸的主人。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Does that mean Necron is no more? I have been a mediocre master.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Storm was my favorite sparring partner, you must have enjoyed fighting him!
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：Storm 是我最喜欢的陪练，你和他交手一定很享受吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Storm was my favorite sparring partner, you must have enjoyed fighting him!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: This world isn’t worth fighting for, how can you be so determined?
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：这个世界不值得为之战斗，你怎能如此坚定？
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: This world isn’t worth fighting for, how can you be so determined?

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Mortals fighting against supreme beings, what a moving spectacle.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：凡人与至高存在战斗，多么动人的景象。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Mortals fighting against supreme beings, what a moving spectacle.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I enjoy your passion, if the circumstances had been different, we could have been friends.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：我欣赏你的热情，若情况不同，我们本可以成为朋友。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: I enjoy your passion, if the circumstances had been different, we could have been friends.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I have worked on this spell for centuries.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：我为这个法术钻研了数百年。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: I have worked on this spell for centuries.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Some of you do have some talent, I can feel it, the other ones not so much.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：你们中有些人确实有些天赋，我能感觉到，其他人就差得多了。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Some of you do have some talent, I can feel it, the other ones not so much.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: You are wasting your time.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：你在浪费时间。

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Did you forget? I am invincible!
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：你忘了吗？我是无敌的！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Did you forget? I am invincible!

entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：徒劳。

entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：我可不觉得有什么了不起。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: I am not impressed.

entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Your skills have faded, humans.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Oh, this one hurts!
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：哦，这一下真疼！
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Oh, this one hurts!

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: My soul is disposable.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：我的灵魂是可以舍弃的。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: My soul is disposable.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I have more of those.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：我还有更多这种东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: I have more of those.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Thank you for coming all the way here.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：感谢你远道而来。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Thank you for coming all the way here.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Now I will truly have peace.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：现在我才能真正获得安宁。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Now I will truly have peace.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Let's enjoy your final moments in silence.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：让我们在寂静中享受你的最后时刻吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Let's enjoy your final moments in silence.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Incredible. You did what I couldn't do myself.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：不可思议。你做到了我自己做不到的事。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: Incredible. You did what I couldn't do myself.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: In a way I should thank you, I lost all hopes centuries ago that it would ever end.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：某种意义上我该感谢你，几个世纪前我就已不抱任何希望，以为这一切永远不会结束。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: In a way I should thank you, I lost all hopes centuries ago that it would ever end.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I hope you’ll become the Heroes I could never be.
entries.translation: [BOSS] 凋灵之王：我希望你们能成为我永远无法成为的英雄。
entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: I hope you’ll become the Heroes I could never be.

entries.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: So long champions of this mad world!

entries.sampleRaw: §4[BOSS] The Wither King§c: So long champions of this mad world!
